title: Nothic Eye
summary: Extract three Nothic Eyes for the Elixir of See Invisibility recipe.

fields.Alchemy: Combine three Nothic Eyes to make one Suspension of Nothic Eye. Add any Vitriol to make an Elixir of See Invisibility.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
